data: Which of the following are the possible values of Spearman ρ when Kendall τ is 0?

The question asks for the possible values of Spearman ρ when Kendall τ is 0. From the caption, we know that the gray region represents the values of Spearman ρ that satisfy Eq. 11 as a function of Kendall τ. By examining the figure, we can see that the gray region extends from approximately -1.0 to 1.0 on the y-axis (ρ). At Kendall τ = 0, the gray region appears to be symmetric around 0. Therefore, the possible values of Spearman ρ when Kendall τ is 0 are within the range of -1.0 to 1.0.
